title: Whole blood RNA-seq from healthy adults after vaccination with a replication-competent tetravalent dengue vaccine
description: The primary aim of this study was to characterize the transcriptomic differences between individuals with different follow-up geometric mean neutralizing antibody titers at one month Overall design: 20 healthy adults were sampled for whole blood at five timepoints (d0, d2, d4, d7, d92).
